g.text: on your PC or in your Devin Cloud session
each run is its own session

g.title: Developers, leads. start runs, answer questions
PO, BSA, Scrum Master. backlog, sprint, leave
Runs page. stage rail, questions, gate cards
Backlog grid. estimate, team poker, raise story
Role dashboard. one lens per role (people.yaml)
Test on my PC. runs the story's test pack
Progress reader. [SDLC] lines to timeline, gates
Devin Local. pctest.py on the PC
Bridge outbox. one file per Devin call
Bridge inbox. tool output, API shapes
Host session. /argus in your Devin Cloud
SDLC run session. intake, plan, build, test, release
Day assistant session. menu, chat, dashboard Save
Story insight session. insight, AC rewrite
Bitbucket. devin/* branch, PR to feature
Repo rules and KB. people.yaml, gates, sprint sheets

svg.text: Argus: how it works
Request from a person
Devin call
Progress back
Read
Write after approval
Approval
Developer or lead: Starts a run on the Runs page
Developer or lead: The server saves the run and writes a Devin call to the bridge outbox
Developer or lead: The bridge loop in the host session creates the SDLC run session
Developer or lead: The session reads the repo rules, knowledge base and Snowflake
Developer or lead: Its [SDLC] lines come back to the stage rail and numbered questions
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: Opens the backlog grid
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: A short Jira reader session fetches the tickets
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: The dashboard build session reads people.yaml and builds this role's dashboard
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: Dashboard tabs open; the sprint leave calendar reads the Sprint Leave page
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: Save on a tab sends a SDLC block to the day assistant session
PO, BSA or Scrum Master: After approved: the roster or leave page in Confluence, and a people.yaml PR
Approver: Replies approved on the gate card
Approver: Only now the session writes: Jira story and sub-tasks, Confluence pages, devin/* branch and PR
Approver: The PR state session keeps the Runs page up to date
Approver: A person merges; when Bitbucket has a newer commit the updater restarts Argus
Tester: Presses Test on my PC
Tester: Devin Local runs the story's test pack and sends the evidence to the run session
Tester: The result shows on the Runs page
